entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pavel Rychetský is a Czech lawyer and former politician who was the 3rd President of the Constitutional Court of the Czech Republic. The Senate confirmed him on 16 July 2003 and on 6 August 2003, he was sworn in by President Václav Klaus and reappointed in 2013 by President Miloš Zeman.
